name: Chrome / Edge (Chromium) Browser Artifacts
location: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default (Chrome) or \Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default (Edge); History, Login Data, Web Data, Cookies (under Network\), Bookmarks, Preferences
purpose: SQLite databases and JSON files recording browsing history, downloads, saved logins, autofill, and cookies.
normal_baseline: History reflects normal work-related browsing; Login Data contains credentials for known, approved services.
anomalies: History entries for known malicious-tool download sites or paste sites shortly before an incident
Downloads entry for a payload matching a known hash
Unexpected extension IDs not present in the organization's approved list
anti_forensic_notes: Clearing browsing history removes rows from the SQLite tables but does not necessarily overwrite the underlying file pages, so carving deleted SQLite records can sometimes recover cleared history.
